layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous tactical spacing (py-16 sm:py-24, gap-6 to gap-8). High density grid for catalog (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4).
layout_and_spacing.hero_layout: Asymmetric Split Hero: Left kinetic animated title reveal + CTA buttons + Live Metrics ticker; Right glowing 3D-styled featured product card frame with neon spotlight bleed.
layout_and_spacing.catalog_grid: Grid items direct children of container or motion.div direct wrappers with subgrid/grid-item classes.

product_detail_modal.features: Full screen dialog / overlay with backdrop blur. Shows screenshot gallery, verified rank badge, seller notes, account level, skins count, instant buy CTA button, and direct WhatsApp seller inquiry button.
product_detail_modal.checkout_flow: Modal popup with simulated Stripe payment card form / QRIS payment preview, instant instant order receipt preview.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is in natural Indonesian appropriate for a gaming marketplace (e.g., Igitem style).
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or standard smooth momentum scrolling.
Use framer-motion for kinetic hero line-by-line masked reveals and product card hover animations.
Ensure header has background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#07080B]/80) to prevent text overlap.
Make sure every interactive element (button, input, select, card, modal action) has a clear kebab-case data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use forbidden colors #7351B7 or #1B93A4 anywhere in Tailwind or custom CSS.
Add toast notifications using Sonner when adding items, performing checkout, or updating products in Admin mode.
Keep standard JS/React component architecture (no TypeScript syntax errors).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look best when grounded with crisp 1px borders and targeted neon accent pops.
Do not apply universal transition: all (specify transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
Never center align the App root container text-align.
All interactive components MUST include data-testid attribute.
No plain transparent dropdowns or header backgrounds.
